app.message: Service api is routed by Traefik but has no healthcheck; traffic starts as soon as the container starts
api and web all get the injected route Host(`example.com`); Traefik sends each request to one of them
app.hint: Add `traefik.enable=false` to `deploy.labels` of the services that must not answer on example.com, or give them their own router rule.
